clause: studio_* PostgreSQL tables + dated migrations (foundation set) [STU-ARC-004,STU-CON-004]

scope.summary: Author the foundation studio_* tables (studio_documents SDOC-, studio_layers SLYR-, studio_artboards SART-, studio_page_spreads SPGS-, studio_history_entries SHIS-, studio_edit_proposals SEPR-) as dated migrations (YYYY_MM_DD_studio_*.sql + .down.sql), TEXT PRIMARY KEY prefixed ids, event_ledger_event_id NOT NULL FK, guard_authority_write(Postgres) on every write.
acceptance_criteria: foundation tables migrate on managed Postgres; no SQLite; write-guard proven
proof_targets: live PostgreSQL migration up/down + write-guard test
expected_tests: test: no_sqlite_tripwire fires on any studio_* write without Postgres

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No durable authority store; edits cannot promote.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
